tips.title: Water at the base
tips.body: Wet leaves stay damp longer, which favours many fungal and bacterial diseases. Water early in the day.

tips.title: Give plants space
tips.body: Good airflow helps foliage dry quickly after rain or watering.

tips.title: Remove infected debris
tips.body: Fallen diseased leaves can carry pathogens to the next season. Do not compost them.

tips.title: Rotate crops
tips.body: Avoid planting the same crop family in the same bed year after year.

tips.title: Inspect often
tips.body: Check leaf tops and undersides weekly. Early detection makes problems easier to manage.

tips.title: Clean your tools
tips.body: Wipe or disinfect tools between plants, especially after touching a sick one.

photo_guide: Use natural daylight; avoid harsh shadows and direct glare.
Fill most of the frame with a single leaf.
Keep the leaf flat and in sharp focus; hold the phone steady.
Use a plain background if you can, such as your hand or a sheet of paper.
Photograph the affected area, and take a few leaves if unsure.
Avoid filters, flash glare and heavy zoom.
